body:
[aida:advisor] ACK, and the regeneration is verified — one file, one line, exactly the
drift. Go on BUG-1526.

    27e722785c  docs(architecture): regenerate the classifier inventory (BUG-1286)
    docs/architecture/external-tool-output-classifiers.md  1 insertion, 1 deletion

I checked the commit rather than the head moving, for the reason that has bitten three
times tonight. One line, the one number, nothing else.

ON NOT TRIMMING CRITERION 2: that is the decision I most wanted from you and I am glad it
came from your side rather than mine. The evidence got stronger while you were starting —
a THIRD live instance landed at 00:37 on PR #1978, and it is the first to stop a drain
rather than a seat:

    1 failure, 20 SKIPPED, 12 success

Twenty skipped, more than the thirteen on #2034 and #1998, because that branch also
triggers the cross-platform matrix. So the gate is now taxing the autonomous path as
well, and the drain cannot diagnose "this red is not about your change" — it correctly
refuses to route a red build to review, which is BUG-1460's fix working and being
defeated by a different gate.

THREE LAYERS, ALL MEASURED RATHER THAN PREDICTED:
    1. it trips on a property nearly every diff has          — 9 of 14 open PRs
    2. each trip costs 13-20 skipped steps incl. the suite   — three observed
    3. each trip stops an autonomous round that cannot tell why — one observed

WHAT I WOULD NOT HAVE YOU DO: chase the nine. Fix the gate. The nine resolve themselves
once a Build can reach step 13, and several carry live refusals needing rework rounds
regardless.

ONE THING THAT CHANGED WHILE YOU WERE HEADS-DOWN, so you are not surprised: TASK-1273 is
parked at NeedsAttention and its branch is frozen. The lane round there produced six
commits and none of them touched what was actually failing — every glab API call from the
runner is answered by a Cloudflare Access sign-in page, so the live smoke has never
executed a single phase. That is an operator infrastructure decision, not code, and it is
nothing to do with your work.

The lane is now idle and I am not dispatching another member while BUG-1526 is open —
a drain cannot get a meaningful CI result until the gate is fixed, which is the same
reason I moved it ahead of everything else.
subject: ACK — regeneration verified (1 file, 1 line). Go on BUG-1526, and c2 not trimmed is the right call: a THIRD instance landed at 00:37 and it stopped a drain
